description: Resolve a company domain to that company's subreddit and report its posting cadence, recency, and subscriber count, plus, with the caller's own Serper or Brave search key, a sample of site wide brand mentions. One flat Clay ready row per company. STATUS 12 November 2026: Reddit closed logged out search and ends RSS on 13 November 2026, so actor version 0.3 reads no RSS. The subreddit and its 25 newest posts come from Arctic Shift, a free public archive of Reddit (no key, about 15 minutes behind live Reddit, searches only inside a named subreddit). Mentions across all of Reddit need search_api_key. reddit_route picks the main route (arctic_shift, search_key, both); when it fails or cannot run and the other can, the run switches on its own and says so in route_note, and data_route names the source on every row. Reddit app credentials (redditClientId, redditClientSecret) give a live subscriber count only for apps Reddit approved before 2026-10-31; that route ends when Reddit closes its API by March 2027. A blocked run charges only the start fee. Read only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, for example shopify.com. Supply this or a handle. With a domain the actor runs full discovery; with a handle it skips straight to the fetch.

company_domains.description: Optional. A list of bare company domains. Each becomes its own row, so a list of 500 is one run and one start charge instead of 500.

company_name.description: Optional. Improves search accuracy and is what the identity gate checks a discovered profile against, so supplying it reduces wrong matches.

handle.description: Optional. The subreddit name with or without the r/ prefix, for example stripe. Skips discovery. Read from Arctic Shift, no key needed.

includeFollowerCounts.description: Kept so saved calls still validate. Has no effect in actor version 0.3.

includeMentions.description: true (default) pulls a mention sample when a search key is given; without one the row says needs_search_key and charges nothing for mentions. false for the subreddit only.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

mentionQuery.description: What to search for site wide brand mentions. Needs search_api_key, because Arctic Shift searches only inside a named subreddit. Defaults to the domain in quotes, which is more precise than the brand name.

redditClientId.description: Optional. The caller's own Reddit app client id, for a live subscriber count and as a fallback when Arctic Shift fails. Only for apps Reddit approved before 2026-10-31, when Reddit stopped approving new apps; this route ends when Reddit closes its API by March 2027.

redditClientSecret.description: The caller's own Reddit app client secret, paired with the client id. Used for that run only and never stored.

reddit_route.description: Main route. arctic_shift (default): free Arctic Shift archive, no key. search_key: the caller's Serper or Brave key searches site:reddit.com for the subreddit and mentions. both: use both and merge. The run falls back to the other route on its own when the main one fails and the other can run. With no key, every choice runs as arctic_shift.

search_api_key.description: The caller's own Serper or Brave Search API key. Needed for brand mentions across all of Reddit. Used for that run only, never stored, never written to a row. The provider bills the caller for up to 2 searches per company.

search_provider.description: The provider of search_api_key: serper (serper.dev) or brave (Brave Search API). Defaults to serper when a key is given.

skipCache.description: Kept so saved calls still validate. Has no effect in actor version 0.3.
